svg.text: TẦNG 3 — rear bedroom 14.2 m² split into bedroom + workspace
Four options, same scale. Orange = new work. Rear (LÔ GIA + WC) at top; the room's only opening to daylight is the lô gia door, rear-east.
Study at the rear, on the lô gia
BÀN LÀM VIỆC 5.9 m² · P.NGỦ 7.8 m²
Desk sits on the only daylight the
room has; the WC stays with the
study, so it is out of the bed zone.
you cross the study to reach the WC.
Study at the entry, bed at the rear
BÀN LÀM VIỆC 5.0 m² · P.NGỦ 8.9 m²
Work zone at the door — no crossing
the bedroom for a guest or delivery.
Bedroom keeps both the lô gia and
the WC, at its best size.
− No daylight in the study: needs the
glazed upper band, or a screen wall.

two people; study gets the WC, the

Bed raised +1400 on a platform with

the bed; reads as a single room.
Scale ≈ 1:50 (1 m = 20 mm). Walls: party 200, partitions 100, new partition shown 100 stud hoặc kính. Furniture indicative. Sources: contractor/MB 2-3-4-Model.pdf + designs/contractor-as-drawn.json.
